summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py (base "json.", one combined regex for brace, bool_true, bool_false, null, number incl. hex, and str); six json.* entries in rich/default_styles.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or NullHighlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns text) and a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and an "Unable to read" stderr error with exit -1; Console.print_json after print in rich/console.py (lazy import, self.print); package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py delegating to get_console(). Docs: "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, new docs/source/reference/json.rst added to reference.rst toctree. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry. Tests in new tests/test_json.py (truecolor styled output and package-level plain output); existing tests untouched. Nothing was executed, so the hand-derived ANSI expectations in the styled test are unverified. Caveat: running rich/json.py directly as a script would shadow the stdlib json module; use python -m rich.json. Overflow is set to None per the spec's "none" wording.
